# Perspect AI

> AI-powered talent assessment platform combining game science, psychology, and data science to predict job performance and streamline remote hiring.

Perspect AI provides comprehensive pre-employment assessments including game-based evaluations, personality tests, skill assessments, and AI video interviews. The platform uses advanced proctoring, multilingual support, and custom assessment builders to help organizations identify top talent efficiently.

## Key Topics

- Game-Based Assessments
- AI Video Interview
- Skill Assessments
- Personality Assessments
- Programming Test
- English Language Assessments
- AI Proctoring
- Talent Evaluation

- Multilingual Support
- Remote Hiring
- Recruitment Automation

## Assessment Products

- [Game-Based Assessments](https://perspect.ai/products/game-based-assessments): Game-based assessment product for predicting job performance
- [AI Video Interview](https://perspect.ai/products/ai-video-interview): AI-powered one-way video interview for remote hiring automation
- [Skill Assessments](https://perspect.ai/products/skill-assessments): AI-powered skill assessments for talent evaluation and screening
- [Personality Assessments](https://perspect.ai/products/personality-assessments): Big 5 personality tests for candidate evaluation and hiring
- [Programming Test](https://perspect.ai/products/programming): Comprehensive programming assessment for developer candidate screening
- [English Language Assessments](https://perspect.ai/products/english-language-assessments): AI-powered English proficiency assessment for non-native speakers
- [Custom Assessments](https://perspect.ai/products/custom-assessments): No-code custom assessment builder for recruitment customization
- [Multi-Measure Assessments](https://perspect.ai/multi-measure-assessments): Multi-method assessment approach for comprehensive candidate evaluation

## Platform Features

- [AI Proctoring Solutions](https://perspect.ai/features/ai-proctoring): AI proctoring with candidate authentication and exam security features
- [Multilingual Assessments](https://perspect.ai/features/multi-lingual): Vernacular language assessments for untapped talent acquisition
